title: Fable 5.2 One-Shotted My Nephew's Dream Game (not by me)
author: VegaKH
selftext: This article is not by me, but I was impressed by what Fable built with minimal guidance.

comments.author: Ok-Pirate5732
comments.body: "one-shotted" and "dream game" in the same title, time to change the meta

comments.author: throwaway09234023322
comments.body: Makes sense. It is stuck at the punch screen for me. Haha

replies.author: VegaKH
replies.body: When in doubt, try hitting J or space bar. It could use some better instructions.

comments.author: Valdaraak
comments.body: If your dream game can be made with a one-shot prompt, you need to raise your standards.

comments.author: VegaKH
comments.body:
It certainly could use some polish. J and K are kick and punch on keyboard. Space bar can get through the menus. The first boss fight with the snake is actually challenging.

As noted, this is not my own and I'm not promoting it. I just thought it looked and played pretty well for a one-shot.

comments.author: Ravenravine2
comments.body: If you can one shot your game, then someone else can one shot your game. Zero sum
